request: Find reusable public Legion7.3.5 artifact scenarios before reconstructing all classes from video; start with TrinityCore history
scope: Bounded source review, not an exhaustive GitHub search or36-scenario client certification. No external implementation was imported and no executable/database changes belong to this research.

newer_reference_only.finding: Newer BFA-oriented tree has additional artifact sources for Tirisfal, Karazhan, Ursoc, Falanaar, Restoration and Mage content. These are useful references for actors, dialogue, event order and spell IDs, not compatible ready-made7.3.5 replacements.
reviewed_examples: scenario_artifact_truthguard.cpp declares Hunter criterion tree IDs but registers only its Paladin instance, Orik and shield object; those declarations do not implement Titanstrike's winds/runes/workshop.

scenario_artifact_ursocslair.cpp npc_lea_stonepaw_105243::MoveInLineOfSight calls player->GetScenario()->CompleteScenario after nearby-player handling. This bypass-shaped progression and its null/scenario assumptions need review before any adaptation.

scenario_artifact_karazhan_catacombs.cpp uses newer InstanceScenario/PhasingHandler APIs and local stage numbering. Those APIs and stages cannot be copied over our verified988 stage gates without mapping them to native7.3.5 criteria.

targeted_objective_reuse.finding: Original local TDB735 archive five41105 objective rows plus POIs provide independent narrative Order and unique StorageIndex0/3/4/1/2 data, VerifiedBuild25549. This bounded data comparison supports54 and the scoped native ordering repair after aggregate-zero character-progress preflight; it does not provide the missing Arms departure actor or an exact26972/full-scenario donor. No bulk base import or character conversion.

reuse_decision: No complete, proven all36 acquisition package was found among the examined sources. Closely related LegionCore forks already share our24 native artifact CPP files; a bulk overwrite offers no demonstrated completion benefit.

For each remaining route, compare a pinned donor's actual changed actor/spell/waypoint/SmartAI/condition rows against our36-route native audit, then port only absent compatible behavior. Missing dedicated CPP is not proof of missing content: many local chains use SmartAI.

Preserve current post-scaling killing-blow protection, owner/pet credit, scenario resume, movement/camera/pet restoration, actual item pickup and our class/race invitation conditions. Map encounter logic is normally class/spec specific; native race eligibility and faction invitation/transport differences must still be checked separately.

Before accepting a port, verify matching26972 DB2/IDs and schema/API semantics, complete LINK graph/condition origins, real visual attachments and progression/cleanup/re-entry/failed-cast cases. Keep source license/attribution. A compiled donor or its README is not a client playthrough.
local_status: All3 Warlock weapons were reported traversed/repaired by the user; Hunter ship tutorial reached the island and Titanstrike entrance Stage1-to-Stage2 was just confirmed. Hunter's other2 artifacts and all later untested Titanstrike visuals are not thereby certified. Existing all-class invitation audit covers149 native race/class pairs and36 acquisition starts, not complete36 chains.
tornado_clarification: Current local FierceWinds starts its route without a passenger prerequisite and unconditionally despawns/cleans its AT at the endpoint. RemoveAllPassengers only releases someone if boarding actually occurred. Released empty tornadoes must travel and disappear empty; killing the caster must not remove an already released tornado.
limits: Repository trees and selected source sections were inspected at pinned commits; no donor server was executed and complete external base databases/SQL graphs were not compared. No assertion that all GitHub repositories, private projects, older branches or client behaviors have been exhausted.
